scope: Interactive tools that accept unpublished text or manuscript files

allowedMeasurementOutsideToolPage: aggregate site metrics that cannot access manuscript input

manualQa: Open DevTools Network before pasting text
Confirm no request is emitted by the tool action

limitations: A static audit is a preflight, not a formal proof of security.
Same-origin HTML, CSS, JavaScript and images are still downloaded when the page itself loads.
Browser extensions and compromised browser software are outside the site's threat model.
